body:
Integration-owner trap (Termal::Opus2). The CLAUDE.md test-ref rule pushes only a merge-ready input: "a fresh focused compile and tests covering its changes and new tests have passed on THAT EXACT input". A carry creates a new input, even when its contribution is byte-identical (same paths, blob ids and modes). A byte-identical contribution lets the carry adopt the earlier REVIEW pair; it never stands in for the focused run.
RULE: before git push origin <commit>:refs/heads/test/..., cite on the item a passed focused run whose TREE equals the pushed tree. A run on the pre-carry tree does not count. If none exists, book one and wait. Put this check in the pre-commit freeze record itself, so the record cannot be written without it. Also re-read the producer's mailbox right before the push, because holds often cross.
Occurrences:
1. 2026-10-30, w-214437118fcf. The focused evidence was on e1ba31fb, not on the carried ce2fa40f. The ref was deleted 24 s after the push; no run used it.
2. 2026-11-16, w-5c8b45a10439. The only focused evidence was on 7b3d5cab / tree 71e06656, not on the carried f70bfb8f / tree 32c31679. The ref cca062de was pushed at 19:07:12Z, Sol-c593 caught it (#2001), and the ref was deleted at 19:10:26Z. FULL-1 had already started from that ref and became evidence only.
